description: Reference choreography from the @sbbyj TikTok (solo, full body, kitchen; dance content 0-15.0 s, then a ~4 s end card with no dancer). Move boundaries from the wrist/elbow trajectories, hip x, shoulder width (body twists) and upper/lower-body motion energy of data/dance/pose/sbbyj_a80421.npz, checked against frame strips of data/dance/pose/sbbyj_a80421.pose.mp4 (see docs/DANCE_MODEL_INTERFACE.md section 4 for the schema). Sides are given as seen on screen; the learner mirrors the screen.
bpm_estimate_note: Estimated, not from a track id: the chest sweeps in 4.4-8.3 s repeat every ~0.67 s (autocorrelation peak of both wrists' x at 0.667 s, about 90 bpm), and an onset-autocorrelation of the clip audio over 0-15 s peaks at ~87.6 bpm (double-time 175 bpm is the runner-up). Treat as 88 +/- 2 bpm.

moves.name: Ready: steps back from the camera, then stands still with arms at the sides
Screen-right arm swings out and up until the hand is beside the head, then drops back to the side
Both hands rise to the chest and sweep side to side together; at each screen-right end the screen-right hand flicks up beside the head (3 sweeps)
Chest sweeps continue: forearms cross over the chest to the screen-left and back, screen-right hand flicking up beside the head (3 more sweeps)
Both hands held in front of the chest, forearms level and close together, nearly still

Twist to the screen-left with forearms stacked at the chest, screen-left hand points out to the side, then the screen-right hand flicks up beside the head and points out to the screen-right with a twist
Repeat: twist left with forearms stacked at the chest, point out to the screen-left, flick the screen-right hand up beside the head, point out to the screen-right, hands back to the chest

Repeat: twist left with forearms stacked at the chest, point out to the screen-left, flick the screen-right hand up beside the head, point out to the screen-right, ending with arms crossed at the chest

notes: Dancer is present (ok=True) in frames 0-450 only (0.0-15.0 s); frames 451-570 are the TikTok end card, so the last move ends at 15.0 s.
'ready' is the count-in: the dancer starts close to the camera, walks backward during 0-1.4 s and stands with arms down until 3.4 s, when the first real move begins.
All 17 COCO joints are visible in >=95% of ok frames (ears 78-85%), so leg/ankle faults can fire on this dance; footwork is small (hip x shifts of ~4% of frame width during the twist_point moves).
Chest sweeps (4.4-8.3 s) repeat every ~0.67 s with both wrists moving in phase; split into two moves at a motion-energy valley (6.4 s) to keep moves near 2 s.

twist_point_1..3 are three repetitions of one ~2 s phrase (hip x and wrist x autocorrelate at 2.07 s); cycle starts are placed at the arms-crossed twist (shoulder-width minima at 9.77, 11.13, 13.17 s).
Screen-left/right in move names are image sides of the mirrored clip; with learner_mirrors_screen the learner's own right hand follows the screen-right side.
